title: FM Broadcast Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using broadcast FM method, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets Output signal sample rate 240e3; {Frequency deviation (Hz)} sets the peak deviation of modulator output signal frequency, {Pre-emphasis filter time constant (s)} sets the pre-emphasis highpass filter time constant, {Sample rate of audio input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input audio signal, {Stereo audio} sets the option to enable stereo modulation, {RDS/RBDS modulation} sets the option to enable RDS, {Oversampling factor of RDS/RBDS input} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In1
ports.summary: Audio signal N -element column vector | 2-by- N matrix

ports.name: In2
ports.summary: RDS (or RBDS) signal N -element column vector | 2-by- N matrix

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Output signal sample rate 240e3 | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency deviation (Hz)
params.values: Peak deviation of modulator output signal frequency 75e3 | positive scalar

params.name: Pre-emphasis filter time constant (s)
params.values: Pre-emphasis highpass filter time constant 7.5e-05 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate of audio input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input audio signal 48000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stereo audio
params.values: Option to enable stereo modulation off (default) | on

params.name: RDS/RBDS modulation
params.values: Option to enable RDS (or RBDS) waveform modulation off (default) | on

params.name: Oversampling factor of RDS/RBDS input
params.values: Oversampling factor of RDS (or RBDS) input signal 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
